verified_context: DynaVelo infers cell-state dynamics from single-cell RNA and chromatin-accessibility snapshots in murine germinal-center B cells. The same team tested nominated perturbations in mice; this preclinical setting does not establish human therapeutic benefit.
visual_idea: A cellular observation field and a visibly separate layer of inferred traces: biological snapshots are the observations, while the traces are a wordless editorial metaphor for model inference, not a factual pathway or vector-field plot.
constraints: Scientific Editorial Abstraction, scientific-1. Standalone 3:2 landscape science magazine illustration, crop-safe in central 16:9 and 3:2. White #FFFFFF dominates; ink #424242, teals #51796E/#344F51 structure, pale sage #E8EFEC and mist #D1E0E2 layers, sparing rose #D4A298/caramel #BC8A5F. Simplified membrane outlines and large nuclei evoke B cells without claiming specimen-specific morphology. Distinguish source-supported cellular subject, deliberately simplified forms and editorial inferred traces. Three pilot compositions: A a shallow tissue-like field beside a detached translucent trace plane; B a large cluster of cut-paper cell cross-sections with an offset fine-line inference veil; C a close cellular field seen across a lifted translucent observation layer with separate unconnected traces. All are illustrations, not microscopy, plots or accurate gene-regulatory mechanisms. No measured cell counts, zone ratios, rescue magnitudes, disease-vs-healthy coding, human treatment or clinical benefit. Reject generic stock cell wallpaper; the separated inference layer is the editorial point. No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, UI, screenshot, actual patient, researcher, institution, study apparatus, generated medical scans, documentary histology, invented pathway, diagnostic feature, fake chart, data scale, watermark, border, frame, neon, robot, glowing brain, decorative floating molecules, glossy 3D, excessive gradient or webpage furniture. First batch limited to three outputs; one revised batch maximum before checkpointing a blocker.
